text:
The query mix favors Mealime and ReciMe: many prompts ask for general planning, recipes, grocery lists, or importing and sharing recipes. “Meal planning app like Mealime” is a direct trigger for naming Mealime, including as a comparison. MyFitnessPal is more likely on calorie, macro, weight, and fitness prompts; HelloFresh may come up for family and regional meal planning, though it is often framed as a meal kit service. Tasty is primarily a recipe app, so its connection is weaker. These are estimates of whether an answer would name each app at least once, not its chance of being recommended. The product associations are supported by the apps’ own feature pages for [MyFitnessPal](https://support.myfitnesspal.com/hc/en-us/articles/34603055097869-How-to-use-the-Meal-Planner), [ReciMe](https://recime.app/help/en/articles/11594896-que-es-recime), [Mealime](https://support.mealime.com/article/151-getting-started-guide), [HelloFresh](https://hellofreshgroup.com/en/newsroom/stories/from-subscription-management-tool-to-daily-food-companion-the-hellofresh/), and [Tasty](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.buzzfeed.tasty).
